findings.claim: Acceptance criterion 2.5 ('.windsurf/workflows (19 files) untouched') and the Impact section ('out of scope either way') are violated: the change deletes 10 of the 19 .windsurf/workflows files (the opsx-* set), leaving only the 9 KBD-authored ones.
findings.evidence: Commit message in the diff: 'git rm the 20 deleted .windsurf paths (10 skills + 10 opsx-* workflows)' and 'KEEP the 9 KBD-authored .windsurf/workflows (kbd-assess, kbd-plan, ...)' — 10 opsx-* + 9 KBD = the 19 files criterion 2.5 says must be untouched, yet 10 were removed and the criterion is marked [x].
findings.suggested_fix: Either restore the opsx-* workflows under .windsurf/workflows (if they must be untouched), or amend the acceptance criteria/Impact to scope out only the 9 KBD-authored workflows and explicitly approve removing the 10 OpenSpec-generated opsx-* workflows.

findings.claim: Acceptance criteria 1.3B and 2.4 ('Re-run and commit the output of generate-skill-system-distribution.js, install-system.js, skill-matrix.js'; 'Distribution output regenerated and committed — no drift') are marked [x] but were not performed: the commit states the named consumers were never run against this edit and the actual generator output was reverted, not committed.
findings.evidence: Commit message D-4: 'task 1.3B named three consumers ... NONE of them reads it' and 'Running the real generator produced drift in hooks/*.json and shared/harnesses/generated/* ... Reverted rather than committed'. This directly contradicts the checked criteria 1.3B and 2.4.
findings.suggested_fix: Un-check or rewrite 1.3B/2.4 to reflect the corrected consumer list, and record that generator output was deliberately not committed (with the c400 D-2 cross-reference) as the accepted resolution instead of claiming 'no drift'.

findings.claim: Criterion 1.1 required deciding A (regenerate .windsurf/skills) or B (retire Windsurf: remove skill-system.json:144 and every reference); the change implements an unlisted third option — retargeting line 144 to devin while keeping .windsurf in detect — and both 1.2A and 1.2B are marked [x] even though neither was executed as written (skills were neither regenerated nor was line 144 removed).
findings.evidence: Commit message: 'The plan's option A was also impossible as written' and 'skill-system.json:144 retargeted windsurf -> devin, path .devin/skills, with .windsurf and command:windsurf KEPT in `detect`'. Criteria: '1.2A Regenerate .windsurf/skills' [x] — .windsurf/skills was deleted, not regenerated; '1.2B Remove skill-system.json:144' [x] — the line was retargeted, not removed.
findings.suggested_fix: Update the change's spec/criteria to add the rename-retarget as option C with its rationale, and correct the 1.2A/1.2B checkmarks so the acceptance record matches what actually shipped.

findings.claim: Criterion 2.3 (`grep -rn ".windsurf/skills"` outside .kbd-orchestrator/ returns nothing unresolved) is only satisfied by author judgment: literal .windsurf/skills references remain in docs/deep-research/** and .windsurf is deliberately retained in skill-system.json's detect list, so 'unresolved' is an unverifiable classification made by the author rather than a demonstrated grep result.
findings.evidence: Commit message D-5: 'the remaining .windsurf/skills references are in docs/deep-research/** ... They are accurate and are not references to this repo's tree', and '.windsurf and command:windsurf KEPT in `detect`'.
findings.suggested_fix: Attach the actual grep output (with per-hit disposition) to the change artifacts so the 2.3 verification is reproducible rather than assertion-based.

findings.claim: The commit asserts build-codex-plugin.js consumes skill-system.json and therefore 'the manifest edit does engage C-01', yet it reverted the regenerated outputs and admits residual drift in hooks/*.json and shared/harnesses/generated/* — by the commit's own reasoning, the repo is left in a state where `npm run validate:codex` cannot pass (no-drift requirement), with the failure deferred to a different change (c400 D-2).
findings.evidence: Constraint C-01: 'npm run validate:codex MUST pass (no drift, valid manifest + marketplace)'. Commit message D-4: 'Running the real generator produced drift in hooks/*.json and shared/harnesses/generated/* ... Reverted rather than committed ... the same pre-existing staleness c400 recorded as D-2.'
findings.suggested_fix: Either decouple the claim (document why skill-system.json is not a C-01 source per the constraint's enumerated list) or land the regenerated artifacts in this change; at minimum, record in the change that validate:codex currently fails and why that is accepted.
